critical_code_review_comments: outline.js isHeadingLine /^\d+[.)]?\s+\S/ also matches ordinary items that start with a quantity, e.g. '2 litres of water' or '10 spare fuses', so with auto-indent on they become headings. Consider requiring '.' or ')' after the number (the default user expectation is '1. Deck').

CreateListDialog toLines silently removes duplicate lines (case-insensitive) across the whole paste, so a repeated item like 'Check bilge' under two categories is kept only once. The item count reflects this, but there is no notice.
Backend to_lines removes duplicate items across groups too, and keeps a heading even if all of its items were removed as duplicates (empty heading).
The UI upgrade modal shows NZD 49.99/year but test_credentials.md says NZD 9.99. Check which price is correct.
